segments.text: This mouse is the strangest gaming mouse in the world.
It's called the Roccat Egor Strike Seven.
It's a wireless mouse and has all the buttons like any normal mouse.
But it looks like a gun and also has a mechanical gun button.
What's special about it is that it's very comfortable during gameplay and also very fun.
Because it's realistic and has a vibration for recoil. The mouse vibrates with you every time you shoot like recoil.
So if you like the mouse, the link is in the bio.
